brief: Charge specific baryon mass relations with deformed SU_q(3) flavor symmetry (Gresnigt, arXiv:1607.01632) — q-deformed octet/decuplet mass formulas with q fitted at a root of unity
extended:
**Charge specific baryon mass relations with deformed SU_q(3) flavor symmetry** — Niels G. Gresnigt. arXiv:1607.01632v2 [hep-ph].

Takes the quantum group U_q(su(3)) as a baryon flavour symmetry and adds zeroth-order electromagnetic contributions, giving charge-specific q-deformed octet and decuplet mass formulas (errors quoted 0.02 % and 0.08 %, against the Gell-Mann–Okubo formulas), an octet–decuplet relation (1.2 %), and a formula for the Cabibbo angle, taken as π/14, in terms of q and the spin-parity of the baryons. The deformation parameter is a root of unity selected to match the measured masses.

**Why it may bear here.** Not cited yet. Background for `gresnigt2017`, whose §(i) reviews this programme. A contrast, not a precedent: q here is a flavour parameter chosen by fit, which this repository's anti-fit rule excludes, and it does not enter any braiding.
